sources.reliability_limits: Feed and item page fetched and read in full on 2026-10-25 (newest item 2026-10-23-usage-metrics-api-adds-usage-from-tools-like-opencode). Changelog items describe GitHub product changes only; they do not prove this workspace uses the feature.

learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog item 2026-10-23-usage-metrics-api-adds-usage-from-tools-like-opencode (23 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-25) states the Copilot usage metrics API adds an additive totals_by_client array to enterprise, organization, enterprise-user and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports (in 28-day reports inside each day_totals entry). Each entry has client (e.g. opencode, claude_code, codex, zed, copilot_cli, github_app, cloud_agent, code_review, vscode, jetbrains, else other), request_count (model calls, not prompts), session_count, token_usage and totals_by_model with model_selection_mode user_selected/auto/product_selected/other/unknown. Client is a best-effort grouping by integration ID, not a verified identity; access needs enterprise/org owner, billing manager or View Copilot Metrics role and the Copilot usage metrics policy enabled; the array is empty when there is no usage.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if the system plan ever reports Copilot usage for an org/enterprise; then read totals_by_client per day, do not compare request_count with prompt counts, and treat client as best-effort. No operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Search system scripts for Copilot usage metrics API calls (totals_by_ide / copilot metrics endpoints); record found/not-found before 2026-11-01.

learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: Unlink a customer's identity provider subject with the GraphQL Admin API
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog page unlink-a-customers-identity-provider-subject-with-the-admin-graphql-api (published 23 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-25, HTTP 200) states that as of GraphQL Admin API 2027-01 the identityProviderSubjectDelete mutation unlinks a customer from a third-party identity provider, taking customerId and the subject id (from Customer.identityProviderSubjects). Unlinking signs the customer out of all existing sessions; the next sign-in through that identity provider links them again. It requires the write_customers access scope.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if video_shopify manages customer accounts linked to a third-party identity provider; then use Admin API 2027-01 with write_customers, and expect forced sign-out plus re-link on next IdP sign-in (it is not a permanent block). No operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Search video_shopify code for customer identity provider / SSO handling and the Admin API version and scopes in use; record found/not-found before 2026-11-01.
